content.description: Wire the final 10 form pages (24 text fields + 2 currency upgrades) across 5 modules to use master data lookups from src/lib/lookups.ts instead of free-text inputs. These are the remaining gaps after F-003 was completed. No edit pages exist for these modules — only new/page.tsx files need wiring.
capabilities: All port/location fields in equipment, transshipment, fleet, and ECR modules render as select dropdowns from mdm_ports via getPortOptions()
All vessel fields in transshipment-hub and fleet-deployment modules render as select dropdowns from mdm_vessels via getVesselOptions()
All customer/counterparty/lessor fields in equipment and fleet-deployment modules render as select dropdowns from mdm_customers via getCustomerOptions()
All container type fields in container-leasing and ECR modules render as select dropdowns from mdm_container_types via getContainerTypeOptions()
Depot/terminal fields in container-leasing render as select dropdowns from mdm_terminals via getTerminalOptions()
Hardcoded 5-currency selects in equipment on-hire and leased-containers upgraded to full 20-currency getCurrencyOptions()
acceptance_criteria: equipment-control-yard-managem/new/page.tsx: currentPort field uses getPortOptions() — type:'select' with DB-sourced options
equipment-control-yard-managem/on-hire-off-hire/new/page.tsx: onHireLocation+offHireLocation use getPortOptions(), lessorName+lesseeName use getCustomerOptions(), currency uses getCurrencyOptions()
equipment-control-yard-managem/leased-containers/new/page.tsx: pickUpLocation+dropOffLocation use getPortOptions(), lessorName uses getCustomerOptions(), currency uses getCurrencyOptions()
container-leasing-management/onhire-offhires/new/page.tsx: eventLocation uses getPortOptions(), depotName uses getTerminalOptions(), containerType uses getContainerTypeOptions()
transshipment-hub-management/cargo-trackings/new/page.tsx: hubPort uses getPortOptions(), inboundVessel+outboundVessel use getVesselOptions()
transshipment-hub-management/feeder-coordinations/new/page.tsx: feederVessel+motherVessel use getVesselOptions(), hubPort uses getPortOptions()
fleet-deployment-planning/deployment-contracts/new/page.tsx: vesselName uses getVesselOptions(), counterparty uses getCustomerOptions()
empty-container-repositioning-ai/leasing-decisions/new/page.tsx: containerType uses getContainerTypeOptions(), locationCode uses getPortOptions()
All 10 pages import session via getSession() and pass tenantId to lookup functions
npx tsc --noEmit passes with 0 errors after changes
edge_cases: Master data table empty for a tenant — dropdown shows only 'Select...' placeholder, form can still submit with empty value for optional fields
Existing records created with free-text values before wiring — not affected (only new/page.tsx exists, no edit pages)
Multiple tenants — each sees only their own master data via tenantId filter in lookup queries
Large master data sets — capped at 50 results per lookup function, ordered alphabetically
Currency upgrade from 5→20 options — existing hardcoded values (USD, QAR, AED, SAR, INR) are all in the full list, no data migration needed
error_handling: DB query failure in any lookup function — Next.js error boundary catches and shows error page (existing pattern from F-003)
Session not found — redirect to /login (already handled in each page)
Form submission with value not in current lookup list — API validation accepts loosely on reference fields (existing D-002 decision)
security_considerations: All lookup queries filter by tenantId — no cross-tenant data leakage
Server-side fetching only — lookup data never exposed via client API routes
Permission checks already exist on each page — no changes needed
content.implementation_notes: Pattern is identical to F-003: (1) import lookup functions from @/lib/lookups, (2) call them in the server component with session.tenantId, (3) replace type:'text' with type:'select' and options:lookupResult in the FieldConfig array. For currency upgrades, replace inline hardcoded options array with getCurrencyOptions(). No new lookup functions needed — all 8 already exist in lookups.ts.
testing_requirements: Each of the 10 form pages loads without errors when navigated to
All select dropdowns render with options from the lookup functions
Selecting a value and submitting the form creates a record with the correct value
Forms with no master data for the tenant show empty select with placeholder
